title: Pakistan Air Force Museum
geometryBasis: The public Pakistan Air Force Museum site in November 2016, including the Archive Gallery and its shallow glazed gable, the public entrance, Martyrs’ Monument, and the mapped visitor and service buildings within the museum park.
sectionBasis: The native public museum park and named Archive Gallery, five exact cleared Qualla photos, the museum’s public attraction and building descriptions, and the frozen original local terrain.
limitations: The model depicts the public museum’s November 2016 exterior. The Archive Gallery and visitor buildings follow mapped outlines. Roof sections, glazing, colors after accounting for nighttime illumination and the gallery vestibule depth are estimated.
The public entrance and memorial positions are approximate. The native mapped roads and plaza establish the local context and the cleared photographs establish form.

Original terrain remains unchanged. Foundations and visitor path grades are estimated. Exact memorial inscriptions, aircraft displays and material inside the main exhibit room are outside the modeled scope.
